checks.text: With no entries, the page shows the heading "Weight Tracker", the text "No entries yet", and the button "Add entry".

Clicking "Add entry" opens a form with fields labelled "Date" and "Weight (kg)". Typing "2024-01-15" in the field labelled "Date" and "72.5" in the field labelled "Weight (kg)", then clicking "Save", adds a list item containing "2024-01-15" and "72.5 kg". The text "No entries yet" is gone.

After adding an entry with Date "2024-01-15" and Weight "72.5", adding another entry with Date "2024-01-22" and Weight "71.8" shows a list item containing "2024-01-22" and "71.8 kg", and the summary line "Change: -0.7 kg".
Clicking "Save" with an empty Weight field or a Weight of "0" adds no list item and shows the message "Enter a weight greater than 0".

Every list item has a button named "Delete <date>". With entries for 2024-01-15 and 2024-01-22, clicking "Delete 2024-01-15" removes that item, leaving only the item with "2024-01-22" and "71.8 kg", and the summary line "Change: -0.7 kg" is gone.
With entries for 2024-01-15 (72.5 kg) and 2024-01-22 (71.8 kg), the SVG line chart contains a path element and two circle elements representing the data points.
With entries for 2024-01-15 (72.5 kg) and 2024-01-22 (71.8 kg), the summary shows "Latest: 71.8 kg" and "Change: -0.7 kg".
Typing "abc" in the field labelled "Weight (kg)" and clicking "Save" adds no list item and shows the message "Enter a valid weight".
Reload keeps the entry with "2024-01-15" and "72.5 kg" visible in the list.
